description: SSOT for semantic color tokens. Text colors, surface aliases, and context-dependent mappings. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-color-text-primary.role: Primary text on light backgrounds — neutral-900 per identity.html

TK-color-text-secondary.role: Secondary text, captions, descriptions — neutral-600 per identity.html

TK-color-text-disabled.role: Disabled text on any background — neutral-400 per identity.html

TK-color-text-inverse.role: Text on dark or primary backgrounds

TK-color-background-secondary.role: Secondary background, section surfaces — neutral-100 per identity.html

TK-color-surface-secondary.role: Elevated surface, modal backgrounds — neutral-100 per identity.html
